statement: The entire bilateral grade dilation route to an arithmetic proof of the Riemann Hypothesis is closed (BILATERAL_GRADE_ROUTE_CLOSED) across all four canonical branches: (1) Static Common-Frame: fails cross-term cancellation with X_{xi, W} > 0 strictly under canonical windows (FAIL_COMPLETED_XI_CROSS_TERM_CANCELLATION); (2) Fully Grade-Covariant Pullback: exhibits exact asymptotic coordinate redundancy lim_{T->infty} C_{h,T} = 0 due to dilation isometry (FAIL_GRADE_COORDINATE_REDUNDANCY); (3) Window-Tuning: root cancellation v_*(a) is post-hoc spectral/background-dependent and fails independent arithmetic selection (FAIL_POSTHOC_WINDOW_TUNING); (4) Scale Specificity: dilation centering holds for arbitrary base q > 1 and does not specifically select tau = 2pi (SCALE_GENERIC_NOT_TAU_SPECIFIC).
hypotheses: Static common-frame evaluates X_{xi, W} on fixed probability window W
Covariant pullback evaluates C_{h,T} = M_{0, tau^h T} + M_{0, tau^{-h} T} - 2 M_{0,T}
Window-tuning solves v_*(a) such that X_{diag}(a, v_*(a)) = 0
Scale specificity tests dilation centering under general base q > 1
object_studied: Canonical bilateral grade dilation route and candidate branch space
fourier_normalization: Centered coordinates z = a + it; tau = 2pi; base q > 1
multiplicity_convention: All zero multiplicities and background components included
measure_and_window: Admissible probability windows and scale transformations on R
order_of_limits: Evaluation of finite-T vs infinite-T, finite-N vs infinite-N, and grade variation h -> 0
exact_conclusion: Every canonical bilateral grade branch fails at an exact identified gate; no untested normalization, frame, or arithmetically defined window remains viable within the bilateral candidate class; BILATERAL_GRADE_ROUTE_CLOSED holds.
logical_negation: At least one canonical bilateral grade branch produces an arithmetic zero descent with strictly positive radial defect spectral expansion (FALSIFIED by exhaustive 4-branch gate failure matrix)
falsification_attempts: Audited whether an untested window class in C_c^infty(R) could be uniquely forced by the Euler product (none exists)
Audited whether non-trivial Fourier resonances for tau = 2pi could create arithmetic rigidity (none found; scale-generic)
Tested whether asymptotic coordinate redundancy can be bypassed without breaking dilation covariance (no-go)
Verified that total variation coeff V_2 = 2(||dot G_0||^2 + X_{xi, W}) is strictly positive (+0.09445 > 0 at a=1.5)
